title: Fix the API's CORS allow-list
acceptanceCriteria: An allowed origin is echoed exactly in `access-control-allow-origin` (never `*`), with `access-control-allow-credentials: true` when the config allows credentials
Lookalike origins — a longer host, another port, another scheme — get no `access-control-allow-origin`
Every response says `vary: Origin`, including refused ones and ones without an `Origin` header
An allowed preflight gets `204` with the configured methods, the configured header names (not `*`) and the max age
A preflight from an unlisted origin gets `403` and no grant headers
A request without `Origin`, or an `OPTIONS` without `access-control-request-method`, is passed to the route; the former gets no `access-control-*` headers
